title: ～ばかりか (〜bakarika) ～も
shortExplanation: Not only... but also; more than just; not just
longExplanation: The grammar point ～ばかりか ～も is used to emphasize that something is not limited to only one thing, but also includes another thing. It can be translated as 'not only... but also', 'more than just', or 'not just' in English. This expression is typically used with verbs, adjectives, and nouns.
formation: Verb-casual + ばかりか/も, い-Adjective + ばかりか/も, な-Adjective + だ + ばかりか/も, Noun + だ + ばかりか/も

examples.jp: 彼女は英語ばかりか、フランス語も話せます。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa eigo bakarika, furansugo mo hanasemasu.
examples.en: Not only can she speak English, but she can also speak French.

examples.jp: このレストランは味が良いばかりか、サービスも素晴らしい。
examples.romaji: Kono resutoran wa aji ga yoi bakarika, saabisu mo subarashii.
examples.en: Not only does this restaurant have great taste, but the service is also wonderful.

examples.jp: パーティは楽しかったばかりか、料理も美味しかった。
examples.romaji: Paatii wa tanoshikatta bakarika, ryouri mo oishikatta.
examples.en: Not only was the party fun, but the food was also delicious.

examples.jp: 彼は頭がいいばかりか、スポーツも得意だ。
examples.romaji: Kare wa atama ga ii bakarika, supootsu mo tokui da.
examples.en: Not only is he smart, but he is also good at sports.
